answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 35 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in lagoon, verified in dune, and trellis names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 9 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
